title.zh: 卷九十三 志第四十六 河渠三
title.raw: 卷九十三 志第四十六 河渠三 Volume 93 Treatises 46: Rivers and Canals 3

sentences.zh: 黃河 下

translations.literal: Yellow River, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River, continued

sentences.zh: 元祐八年二月乙卯，三省奉旨：「北流軟堰，並依都水監所奏。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the Yuanyou era, on the day yimao, the Three Departments received an imperial order: "Regarding the soft weir on the northern channel, follow entirely what the Directorate of Waterways has memorialized."
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month of the eighth year of Yuanyou, the Three Departments received an edict: "As to the soft weir on the northern flow, act entirely as the Directorate of Waterways has proposed."

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎蘇轍奏：「臣嘗以謂軟堰不可施於北流，利害甚明。

translations.literal: The Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Che memorialized: "Your servant has held that a soft weir cannot be applied to the northern channel; the advantage and harm are very clear.
translations.idiomatic: Su Che, Vice Director of the Secretariat, submitted: "I have long maintained that a soft weir cannot be used on the northern channel—the tradeoffs are obvious.

sentences.zh: 蓋東流本人力所開，闊止百餘步，冬月河流斷絕，故軟堰可為。

translations.literal: For the eastern channel was opened by human labor, its width only a little over a hundred paces; in winter the river flow ceases entirely, so a soft weir can be built.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern channel was dug by human effort and is only a little over a hundred paces wide; in winter the stream dries up, so a soft weir is feasible there.

sentences.zh: 今北流是大河正溜，此之東流，何止數倍，見今河水行流不絕，軟堰何由能立？

translations.literal: Now the northern channel is the main current of the great river; compared with the eastern channel it is not merely several times greater—at present the river water flows without cease. How could a soft weir be made to stand?
translations.idiomatic: Today the northern channel is the river's main course—many times the eastern flow—and the water never stops running. How could a soft weir possibly hold?

sentences.zh: 蓋水官之意，欲以軟堰為名，實作硬堰，陰為回河之計耳。

translations.literal: The intention of the water officials is to use the name "soft weir" while in fact building a hard weir, secretly making a plan to return the river.
translations.idiomatic: What the water officials really want is to call it a soft weir while building a hard one—a covert scheme to force the river back onto its old course.

sentences.zh: 朝廷既已覺其意，則軟堰之請，不宜復從。」

translations.literal: Since the court has already perceived their intention, the request for a soft weir should not again be followed."
translations.idiomatic: The court has already seen through them; the soft-weir proposal should not be approved again."

sentences.zh: 趙偁亦上議曰：「臣竊謂河事大利害有三，而言者互進其說，或見近忘遠，徼幸盜功，或取此舍彼，譸張昧理。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhen also submitted a proposal, saying: "Your servant privately considers that in river affairs there are three great advantages and harms, yet those who speak advance their views in turn—some seeing what is near and forgetting what is far, seeking luck and stealing merit; some taking this and discarding that, distorting facts and obscuring reason.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhen also submitted a memorial: "I believe river policy turns on three great tradeoffs, yet debaters push rival plans—some fixated on the immediate and blind to the long term, gambling for credit; others seize one option and reject another, twisting facts beyond recognition.

sentences.zh: 遂使大利不明，大害不去，上惑朝聽，下滋民患，橫役枉費，殆無窮已，臣切痛之。

translations.literal: Thus the great advantage is not made clear and the great harm is not removed; above they confuse the court's hearing, below they increase the people's afflictions, corvée labor is wasted in vain, and it seems there will be no end—your servant is deeply pained by this.
translations.idiomatic: The result is that real benefits stay obscure, real harms persist, the throne is misled, the people suffer more, and forced labor is squandered without end. I find this deeply distressing.

sentences.zh: 所謂大利害者：北流全河，患水不能分也；

translations.literal: What are called the great advantages and harms are these: with the northern channel carrying the full river, the worry is that the water cannot be divided;
translations.idiomatic: These three great concerns are: on the northern channel, which carries the full river, the problem is that the water cannot be split off;

sentences.zh: 東流分水，患水不能行也；

translations.literal: with the eastern channel dividing the water, the worry is that the water cannot flow;
translations.idiomatic: on the eastern channel, which diverts water, the problem is that the water cannot run freely;

sentences.zh: 宗城河決，患水不能閉也。

translations.literal: with the breach at Zongcheng, the worry is that the water cannot be closed off.
translations.idiomatic: and at the Zongcheng breach, the problem is that the water cannot be shut in.

sentences.zh: 是三者，去其患則為利，未能去則為害。

translations.literal: In these three cases, if the worry is removed it becomes advantage; if it cannot be removed it becomes harm.
translations.idiomatic: Remove the problem in each case and you gain benefit; fail to remove it and you inherit harm.

sentences.zh: 今不謀此，而議欲專閉北流，止知一日可閉之利，而不知異日既塞之患，止知北流伏槽之水易為力，而不知闞村方漲之勢，未可並以入東流也。

translations.literal: Now without planning for these matters, they discuss wishing solely to close the northern channel, knowing only the advantage that it can be closed for a day and not knowing the worry that once blocked on another day, knowing only that the water in the sunken channel of the northern flow is easy to manage by force, and not knowing that the rising force at Kancun cannot all at once be sent into the eastern channel.
translations.idiomatic: Instead of addressing these issues, they talk only of shutting the northern channel outright—seeing the short-term gain of a day's closure but not the disaster once it is blocked, noting how easy it is to work the sunken northern channel yet ignoring the surge at Kancun, which cannot all be forced into the eastern flow at once.

sentences.zh: 夫欲合河以為利，而不恤上下壅潰之害，是皆見近忘遠，徼幸盜功之事也。

translations.literal: To wish to combine the river for profit without caring about the harm of blockage and breach above and below— these are all matters of seeing what is near and forgetting what is far, seeking luck and stealing merit.
translations.idiomatic: Trying to merge the river for gain while ignoring the risk of jams and breaches up- and downstream is exactly the sort of short-sighted gamble for credit that I described.

sentences.zh: 有司欲斷北流而不執其咎，乃引分水為說，姑為軟堰；

translations.literal: The responsible officials wish to cut off the northern channel yet not bear the blame, so they cite dividing the water as their argument and provisionally build a soft weir;
translations.idiomatic: The agencies want to cut the northern flow but avoid responsibility, so they invoke water division and propose a soft weir;

sentences.zh: 知河沖之不可以軟堰禦，則又為決堰之計。

translations.literal: knowing that the river's rush cannot be defended by a soft weir, they then also make a plan to breach the weir.
translations.idiomatic: when they see the current cannot be held by a soft weir, they plan to breach it anyway.

sentences.zh: 臣恐枉有工費，而以河為戲也。

translations.literal: Your servant fears labor and expense will be wasted in vain, treating the river as a game.
translations.idiomatic: I fear we will waste labor and funds treating the river as a toy.

sentences.zh: 請俟漲水伏槽，觀大河之勢，以治東流、北流。」

translations.literal: I request to wait until the flood water subsides in the channel, observe the force of the great river, and then manage the eastern and northern channels."
translations.idiomatic: Please wait until the flood subsides and the channel settles, observe the main river's behavior, and then decide policy for the eastern and northern flows."

sentences.zh: 五月，水官卒請進梁村上、下約，束狹河門，既涉漲水，遂壅而潰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the water officials at last requested advancing the upper and lower bonds at Liangcun to constrict and narrow the river mouth; once they encountered flood water, they were blocked and then breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the water officials finally pushed to advance the upper and lower bonds at Liangcun to pinch the river mouth; when floodwater hit, the works jammed and collapsed.

sentences.zh: 南犯德清，西決內黃，東淤梁村，北出闞村，宗城決口復行魏店，北流因淤遂斷，河水四出，壞東郡浮梁。

translations.literal: It invaded Deqing to the south, broke out west at Neihuang, silted up Liangcun to the east, issued north at Kancun; the breach at Zongcheng again flowed toward Weidian; the northern channel was cut off because of silt; the river water went out in four directions and destroyed the floating bridges of the eastern commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Water struck Deqing in the south, burst west at Neihuang, silted Liangcun in the east, and spilled north at Kancun; the Zongcheng breach reopened toward Weidian; silt choked off the northern channel; the river fanned out in four directions and wrecked the floating bridges of the eastern prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，監察御史郭知章言：「臣比緣使事至河北，自澶州入北京，渡孫村口，見水趨東者，河甚闊而深；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day bingyin, Supervising Censor Guo Zhizhang said: "Your servant recently, on account of a mission, went to Hebei; from Duanzhou entering Beijing, crossing at Sunkou village, I saw where the water trends east—the river is very broad and deep;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the twelfth month, Supervising Censor Guo Zhizhang reported: "On a recent mission to Hebei I entered Beijing from Duanzhou and crossed at Sunkou village; the water trending east runs very wide and deep;

sentences.zh: 又自北京往洺州，過楊家淺口復渡，見水之趨北者，才十之二三，然後知大河宜閉北行東。

translations.literal: again from Beijing going toward Mingzhou, passing Yangjia shallows and crossing once more, I saw the water trending north was only two or three parts in ten—then I knew the great river ought to have the north closed and flow east.
translations.idiomatic: traveling from Beijing toward Mingzhou and crossing again at Yangjia shallows, I saw only two or three tenths of the water heading north—then I understood that the main river should be closed to the north and sent east.

sentences.zh: 乞下都水監相度。」

translations.literal: I beg that the Directorate of Waterways be ordered to survey and plan."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Directorate of Waterways be instructed to survey the situation."

sentences.zh: 於是吳安持復兼領都水，即建言：「近准朝旨，已堰斷魏店刺子，向下北流一枝斷絕。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wu Anchì again concurrently headed the Directorate of Waterways and at once proposed: "Recently, in accordance with the court order, we have already dammed and cut off the spur at Weidian; the branch of the northern channel below has been severed.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Anchì was again placed in charge of the Directorate of Waterways and immediately proposed: "We have recently followed the court's order and dammed the spur at Weidian, cutting off the lower branch of the northern flow.

sentences.zh: 然東西未有堤岸，若漲水稍大，必披灘漫出，則平流在北京、恩州界，為害愈甚。

translations.literal: Yet east and west there are no dikes; if the flood water grows somewhat larger, it will certainly spread over the banks and flood out, and then the level flow will be on the border of Beijing and Enzhou— the harm will be still greater.
translations.idiomatic: But there are no dikes on either flank; if the flood rises even slightly, water will spill across the flats, and a sheet flow between Beijing and Enzhou would do even greater damage.

sentences.zh: 乞塞梁村口，縷張包口，開青豐口以東雞爪河，分殺水勢。」

translations.literal: I beg to block Liangcun mouth, tie up Zhangbao mouth, and open the Chicken-Claw River east of Qingfeng mouth to divide and reduce the water's force."
translations.idiomatic: I request blocking Liangcun mouth, sealing Zhangbao mouth, and opening the Chicken-Claw River east of Qingfeng mouth to split and weaken the current."

sentences.zh: 呂大防以其與己意合，向之，詔同北京留守相視。

translations.literal: Lü Dafang, because this agreed with his own intent, endorsed it; an edict ordered him jointly with the Beijing garrison commander to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Dafang endorsed the plan because it matched his views, and an edict ordered him and the Beijing garrison commander to inspect the site together.

sentences.zh: 時範純仁復為右相，與蘇轍力以為不可。

translations.literal: At that time Fan Chunren had again become the right chief councilor; he and Su Che strenuously held that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chunren had returned as chief councilor on the right, and he and Su Che strongly opposed the plan.

sentences.zh: 遂降旨：「令都水監與本路安撫、轉運、提刑司共議，可則行之，有異議速以聞。」

translations.literal: An edict was then issued: "Order the Directorate of Waterways to deliberate jointly with this circuit's Pacification, Transport, and Judicial commissioners; if feasible then carry it out; if there is dissent, report quickly."
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered: "Let the Directorate of Waterways consult with this circuit's pacification, transport, and judicial commissioners; implement if feasible, and report any objections at once."

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年正月也。

translations.literal: This was in the first month of the first year of Shaosheng.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the first month of the first year of Shaosheng.

sentences.zh: 是時，轉運使趙偁深不以為然，提刑上官均頗助之。

translations.literal: At this time Transport Commissioner Zhao Zhen deeply did not approve; Judicial Commissioner Shangguan Jun considerably supported him.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Commissioner Zhao Zhen strongly disagreed, while Judicial Commissioner Shangguan Jun largely backed him.

sentences.zh: 偁之言曰：「河自孟津初行平地，必須全流，乃成河道。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhen's words were: "From Mengjin the river first runs on level ground; it must have the full current before a river course can be formed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhen said: "From Mengjin the river first spreads across level ground; only the full current can carve a stable channel.

sentences.zh: 禹之治水，自冀北抵滄、棣，始播為九河，以其近海無患也。

translations.literal: When Yu controlled the waters, from Jibei reaching Cang and Di, he first spread it into the Nine Rivers, because near the sea there was no worry.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu tamed the floods, he spread the waters into the Nine Rivers from northern Ji to Cang and Di because near the sea there was little risk.

sentences.zh: 今河自橫壟、六塔、商胡、小吳，百年之間，皆從西決，蓋河徙之常勢。

translations.literal: Now the river from Henglong, Liuta, Shanghu, and Xiaowu—within a hundred years—all broke out to the west; this is the constant tendency of the river's shifting.
translations.idiomatic: Over the past century the river has broken west at Henglong, Liuta, Shanghu, and Xiaowu—that is the river's habitual drift.

sentences.zh: 而有司置埽創約，橫截河流，回河不成，因為分水。

translations.literal: Yet the responsible officials set brush revetments and created bonds, cutting across the river flow horizontally; returning the river did not succeed, so they made dividing the water instead.
translations.idiomatic: Officials instead built brush revetments and bonds to cut the flow crosswise; failing to return the river, they turned to splitting the water.

sentences.zh: 初決南宮，再決宗城，三決內黃，亦皆西決，則地勢西下，較然可見。

translations.literal: First it broke at Nangong, again at Zongcheng, a third time at Neihuang—all likewise breaking west; then the terrain sloping down to the west is comparatively clear to see.
translations.idiomatic: First Nangong, then Zongcheng, then Neihuang—each breach to the west—shows plainly that the land slopes downward to the west.

sentences.zh: 今欲弭息河患，而逆地勢，戾水性，臣未見其能就功也。

translations.literal: Now wishing to quell river calamity while going against the terrain's tendency and defying the water's nature—your servant does not see how success can be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: To seek peace on the river while fighting the lay of the land and the nature of the water—I see no way this can succeed.

sentences.zh: 請開闞村河門，修平鄉钜鹿埽、焦家等堤，浚澶淵故道，以備漲水。」

translations.literal: I request opening the river mouth at Kancun, repairing the revetments at Pingxiang, Julu, Jiaojia, and other dikes, and dredging the old course at Danyuan to prepare against flood water."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to open the Kancun river mouth, repair revetments at Pingxiang, Julu, Jiaojia, and elsewhere, and dredge the old Danyuan channel against high water."

sentences.zh: 大名安撫使許將言：「度今之利，若舍故道，止從北流，則慮河下已湮，而上流橫潰，為害益廣。

translations.literal: Daming Pacification Commissioner Xu Jiang said: "Considering present advantage, if one abandons the old course and follows only the northern channel, then one fears the lower river is already silted up while the upper current breaches across— the harm will be still broader.
translations.idiomatic: Daming Pacification Commissioner Xu Jiang said: "Weighing the options today, if we abandon the old course and rely only on the northern flow, we risk a silted lower reach while the upper river bursts sideways—the damage would spread further.

sentences.zh: 若直閉北流，東徙故道，則復慮受水不盡，而破堤為患。

translations.literal: If one directly closes the northern channel and shifts east to the old course, then again one fears it cannot receive all the water and will break the dikes as a calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If we simply shut the northern channel and force the river east into the old course, we again fear the channel cannot take the full volume and the dikes will fail.

sentences.zh: 竊謂宜因梁村之口以行東，因內黃之口以行北，而盡閉諸口，以絕大名諸州之患。

translations.literal: I privately consider it fitting to use Liangcun mouth to run east and Neihuang mouth to run north, while closing all mouths completely, to cut off the calamity to Daming and the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: I believe we should send water east through Liangcun mouth and north through Neihuang mouth, close the other openings entirely, and thus spare Daming and the surrounding prefectures.

sentences.zh: 俟春夏水大至，乃觀故道，足以受之，則內黃之口可塞；

translations.literal: Wait until spring and summer when the water grows great, then observe the old course—if it is sufficient to receive it, then Neihuang mouth can be blocked;
translations.idiomatic: Wait until the spring-summer flood peaks, then test whether the old course can carry the flow; if it can, Neihuang mouth may be sealed;

sentences.zh: 不足以受之，則梁村之役可止。

translations.literal: if it is not sufficient to receive it, then the work at Liangcun can be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: if it cannot, the Liangcun project should be halted.

sentences.zh: 定其成議，則民心固而河之順復有時，可以保其無害。」

translations.literal: Once the settled decision is fixed, then popular sentiment will be firm and the river's return to order will have its time—one can ensure it will be without harm."
translations.idiomatic: Once policy is settled, the people will be reassured and the river can be guided back in due course without harm."

sentences.zh: 詔：「令吳安持同都水監丞鄭佑，與本路安撫、轉運、提刑司官具圖、狀保明聞奏，即有未便，亦具利害來上。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "Order Wu Anchì together with Directorate Vice Director Zheng You and the officials of this circuit's Pacification, Transport, and Judicial offices to prepare maps and reports certifying and memorializing; if there is anything inconvenient, also set forth advantage and harm and submit upward."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered: "Wu Anchì, together with Directorate Vice Director Zheng You and the circuit's pacification, transport, and judicial officials, shall submit certified maps and reports; if anything is impracticable, state the pros and cons as well."

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，監察御史郭知章言：「河復故道，水之趨東，已不可遏。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day guiyou, Supervising Censor Guo Zhizhang said: "The river has returned to the old course; the water trending east can no longer be restrained.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the third month, Supervising Censor Guo Zhizhang said: "The river has returned to its old course and the eastward flow can no longer be stopped.

sentences.zh: 近日遣使按視，逐司議論未一。

translations.literal: Recently envoys were sent to inspect on site, yet the various offices' discussions are not unified.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were recently sent to inspect, yet the agencies still disagree.

sentences.zh: 臣謂水官朝夕從事河上，望專委之。」

translations.literal: Your servant considers that the water officials work on the river day and night; I hope they may be entrusted exclusively."
translations.idiomatic: The water officials work on the river daily; I ask that responsibility be entrusted to them alone."

sentences.zh: 乙亥，呂大防罷相。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Lü Dafang was dismissed from the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Lü Dafang was removed as chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 六月，右正言張商英奏言：「元豐間河決南宮口，講議累年，先帝歎曰：'神禹復生，不能回此河矣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Right Remonstrator Zhang Shangying memorialized, saying: "During the Yuanfeng period the river broke at Nangong mouth; discussion went on for years. The late emperor sighed and said: 'Even if Divine Yu were reborn, he could not return this river.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Right Remonstrator Zhang Shangying submitted: "During Yuanfeng the river broke at Nangong mouth; debate dragged on for years until the late emperor sighed, 'Even if Yu the Great were reborn, he could not turn this river back.

sentences.zh: '乃敕自今後不得復議回河閉口，蓋採用漢人之論，俟其氾濫自定也。

translations.literal: He then ordered that from now on there must be no further discussion of returning the river and closing mouths—this adopted the Han people's view, waiting for its flooding to settle of itself.
translations.idiomatic: He then forbade any further debate on forcing the river back and closing mouths, adopting the Han view to let the floods find their own level.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，文彥博、呂大防以前敕非是，拔吳安持為都水使者，委以東流之事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Wen Yanbo and Lü Dafang held the previous edict to be wrong; they elevated Wu Anchì as Director of Waterways and entrusted him with eastern-channel affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yuanyou, Wen Yanbo and Lü Dafang rejected that edict, promoted Wu Anchì to head the Directorate of Waterways, and put him in charge of the eastern-flow project.

sentences.zh: 京東、河北五百里內差夫，五百里外出錢雇夫，及支借常平倉司錢買梢草，斬伐榆柳。

translations.literal: Within five hundred li of Jingdong and Hebei corvée laborers were drafted; beyond five hundred li money was paid to hire laborers; Ever-Normal Granary funds were borrowed to buy fascine and brush, and elms and willows were cut down.
translations.idiomatic: Within five hundred li of Jingdong and Hebei men were conscripted; beyond that distance hirelings were paid; Ever-Normal Granary funds bought fascines and brush, and elms and willows were felled.

sentences.zh: 凡八年而無尺寸之效，乃遷安持太僕卿，王宗望代之。

translations.literal: In all eight years there was not the slightest effect; then Anchì was transferred to Grandee of the Stud, and Wang Zongwang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: After eight years without measurable success, Anchì was moved to Grandee of the Stud and Wang Zongwang took his place.

sentences.zh: 宗望至，則劉奉世猶以彥博、大防餘意，力主東流，以梁村口吞納大河。

translations.literal: When Zongwang arrived, Liu Fengshi still, following the remaining intent of Yanbo and Dafang, strenuously upheld the eastern channel, using Liangcun mouth to swallow and receive the great river.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang arrived, Liu Fengshi still pressed the eastern-flow policy in the spirit of Yanbo and Dafang, trying to take the full river through Liangcun mouth.

sentences.zh: 今則梁村口淤澱，而開沙堤兩處決口以泄水矣。

translations.literal: Now Liangcun mouth is silted up, yet they have opened two breach points in the sand dike to discharge water.
translations.idiomatic: Now Liangcun mouth is silted shut, yet they have cut two breaches in the sand dike to release water.

sentences.zh: 前議累七十里堤以障北流，今則雲俟霜降水落興工矣。

translations.literal: Previously they discussed piling up seventy li of dike to block the northern channel; now they say they will wait for frost to descend and the water to fall before starting work.
translations.idiomatic: They once planned seventy li of dike to block the northern flow; now they say they will wait until frost and low water before building.

sentences.zh: 朝廷咫尺，不應九年為水官蔽欺如此。

translations.literal: The court is within arm's reach; it ought not that for nine years the water officials could conceal and deceive to this degree.
translations.idiomatic: The court is close at hand; the water officials should not have deceived it for nine years like this.

sentences.zh: 九年之內，年年礬山水漲，霜降水落，豈獨今年始有漲水，而待水落乃可以興工耶？

translations.literal: Within nine years, every year the Fan River waters rose and frost descended and water fell—how is it only this year that flood water first appeared, and that one must wait for water to fall before work can begin?
translations.idiomatic: For nine years the Fan River rose every season and fell with frost—did floods begin only this year, and can work start only after the water drops?

sentences.zh: 乞遣使按驗虛實，取索回河以來公私費錢糧、梢草，依仁宗朝六塔河施行。」

translations.literal: I beg to send envoys to inspect and verify truth and falsehood, and to demand accounts of public and private expenditures in money, grain, and fascine since the return-river policy began, implementing it as in the Liuta River case under Emperor Renzong."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that envoys verify the facts and audit all public and private spending on money, grain, and fascines since the return-river policy began, following the precedent of the Liuta River project under Emperor Renzong."

sentences.zh: 會七月辛丑，廣武埽危急，詔王宗望亟往救護。

translations.literal: It happened that in the seventh month on the day xinchou the Guangwu revetment was critically endangered; an edict ordered Wang Zongwang to go quickly to rescue and protect it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinchou the Guangwu revetment was in critical danger; Wang Zongwang was ordered to rush to the site.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，帝謂輔臣曰：「廣武去洛河不遠，須防漲溢下灌京師，已遣中使視之。」

translations.literal: On the day renyin the emperor said to the chief ministers: "Guangwu is not far from the Luo River; we must guard against flood overflow pouring down to inundate the capital. I have already sent a palace envoy to inspect it."
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the emperor told his ministers: "Guangwu is near the Luo River; we must guard against a flood pouring down on the capital. I have already sent a palace envoy to inspect."

sentences.zh: 輔臣出圖、狀以奏曰：「此由黃河北岸生灘，水趨南岸。

translations.literal: The chief ministers produced maps and reports and memorialized, saying: "This is because on the north bank of the Yellow River a shoal has formed and the water trends toward the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers presented maps and reports: "A shoal has formed on the Yellow River's north bank, driving water toward the south bank.

sentences.zh: 今雨止，河必減落，已下水官，與洛口官同行按視，為簽堤及去北岸嫩灘，令河順直，則無患矣。」

translations.literal: Now the rain has stopped and the river must fall; we have already sent down the water officials to inspect jointly with the Luokou officials, to build tie dikes and remove the tender shoal on the north bank, making the river run straight—then there will be no worry."
translations.idiomatic: The rain has stopped and the river will fall; we have sent water officials with the Luokou staff to inspect, build tie dikes, and clear the soft shoal on the north bank so the river runs straight—then there will be no danger."

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，權工部侍郎吳安持等言：「廣武埽危急，刷塌堤身二千餘步處，地形稍高。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingzi, Acting Vice Minister of Works Wu Anchì and others said: "The Guangwu revetment is critically endangered; where the dike body was scoured away for more than two thousand paces, the terrain is somewhat higher.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eighth month, Acting Vice Minister of Works Wu Anchì and others reported: "The Guangwu revetment is critical; where more than two thousand paces of dike have been scoured away, the ground is slightly higher.

sentences.zh: 自鞏縣東七里店至見今洛口，約不滿十里，可以別開新河，引導河水近南行流，地步至少，用功甚微。

translations.literal: From Qili shop east of Gong county to the present Luokou, it is not quite ten li; one can separately open a new river to guide the river water to run near the south— the ground required is at a minimum and the labor extremely slight.
translations.idiomatic: From Qili shop east of Gong county to the present Luokou is less than ten li; a new channel could divert the river southward with very little land and labor.

sentences.zh: 王宗望行視並開井筒，各稱利便外，其南築大堤，工力浩大，乞下各屬官司，躬往相度保明。」

translations.literal: Wang Zongwang inspected on site and opened well shafts; each declared advantage except that building a great dike to the south would require vast labor—I beg that the various responsible offices go in person to survey and certify."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongwang inspected the site and sank test shafts; all called it advantageous except that a great dike to the south would be enormously costly—I ask the responsible agencies to survey and certify in person."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，王宗望言：「大河自元豐潰決以來，東、北兩流，利害極大，頻年紛爭，國論不決，水官無所適從。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou, Wang Zongwang said: "Since the great river breached in Yuanfeng, the eastern and northern two flows have had extreme advantage and harm; for years there has been dispute, national policy undecided, and the water officials have nowhere to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the tenth month, Wang Zongwang said: "Since Yuanfeng the great river has run in eastern and northern channels with enormous stakes; years of dispute have left national policy unsettled and the water officials without clear direction.

sentences.zh: 伏自奉昭凡九月，上稟成算，自闞村下至栲栳堤七節河門，並皆閉塞。

translations.literal: Since receiving the edict for nine months in all, I have reported the completed plan upward; from Kancun down to the seven-section river mouths at Kaolao dike, all have been closed and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Since receiving the edict nine months ago I have carried out the imperial plan: from Kancun down to the seven river mouths at Kaolao dike, all have been sealed.

sentences.zh: 築金堤七十里，盡障北流，使全河東還故道，以除河患。

translations.literal: We built the Golden Dike for seventy li, fully blocking the northern channel, making the entire river return east to the old course to remove river calamity.
translations.idiomatic: We built seventy li of Golden Dike to block the northern flow entirely and send the whole river east back to the old course, ending the disaster.

sentences.zh: 又自闞村下至海口，補築新舊堤防，增修疏浚河道之淤淺者，雖盛夏漲潦，不至壅決。

translations.literal: Again from Kancun down to the sea mouth we repaired and built old and new dikes, increased repairs and dredged where the river channel was silted and shallow— even in midsummer flood swell it would not reach blockage and breach.
translations.idiomatic: From Kancun to the sea mouth we repaired old and new dikes and dredged silted shallows so that even midsummer floods would not cause jams or breaches.

sentences.zh: 望付史官，紀紹聖以來聖明獨斷，致此成績。」

translations.literal: I hope this may be entrusted to the historiographers to record how since Shaosheng the sage clarity of independent decision achieved this accomplishment."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the historians record how since Shaosheng the emperor's decisive judgment produced this achievement."

sentences.zh: 詔宗望等具析修閉北流部役官等功力等弟以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zongwang and others to set forth in detail the grades of merit of officials and labor in the departments for repairing and closing the northern channel and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Zongwang and others to report in detail the merit grades of officials involved in closing the northern channel.

sentences.zh: 然是時東流堤防未及繕固，瀕河多被水患，流民入京師，往往泊御廊及僧舍。

translations.literal: Yet at this time the eastern-channel dikes and defenses had not yet been repaired and made firm; along the river many suffered water calamity; displaced people entered the capital, often mooring at the imperial galleries and monks' quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the eastern-channel dikes were still not secure; riverside districts suffered floods; refugees entered the capital and often camped along the imperial galleries and in monasteries.

sentences.zh: 詔給券，諭令還本土，以就振濟。

translations.literal: An edict issued passes and instructed them to return to their native places to receive relief.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued travel passes and ordered them home to receive relief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，安持又言：「准朝旨相度開浚澶州故道，分減漲水。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Anchì again said: "In accordance with the court order we have surveyed opening and dredging the old course at Duanzhou to divide and reduce flood water.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Anchì reported again: "Following the court's order we surveyed opening and dredging the old Duanzhou channel to split floodwater.

sentences.zh: 按澶州本是河行舊道，頃年曾乞開修，時以東西地形高仰，未可興工。

translations.literal: According to investigation, Duanzhou was originally the river's old course; in recent years we requested opening and repair, but at the time because the terrain east and west was high and sloped, work could not be started.
translations.idiomatic: Duanzhou was the river's old course; we recently sought to open it, but the east-west gradient was too steep to build then.

sentences.zh: 欲乞且行疏導燕家河，仍令所屬先次計度合增修一十一埽所用工料。」

translations.literal: We wish to beg to carry out dredging of the Yan family river for the present, and still order the subordinates first to calculate the labor and materials needed for repairing the eleven revetments in all."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to dredge the Yan family river for now and have subordinates first estimate materials to repair eleven revetments."

sentences.zh: 詔：「令都水監候來年將及漲水月分，先具利害以聞。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "Order the Directorate of Waterways to wait until next year when the flood-water months approach, and first set forth advantage and harm and report."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered: "The Directorate of Waterways shall report the pros and cons before next year's flood season."

sentences.zh: 癸丑，三省、樞密院言：「元豐八年，知澶州王令圖議，乞修復大河故道。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs said: "In the eighth year of Yuanfeng, Prefect of Duanzhou Wang Lingtu proposed repairing and restoring the great river's old course.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "In the eighth year of Yuanfeng, Duanzhou prefect Wang Lingtu proposed restoring the great river's old course.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年，都水使者吳安持，因紓南宮等埽危急，遂就孫村口為回河之策。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, Director of Waterways Wu Anchì, because of relieving the critical danger at Nangong and other revetments, then made a return-river policy at Sunkou village.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, Director Wu Anchì, seeking to relieve crises at Nangong and other revetments, adopted a return-river plan at Sunkou village.

sentences.zh: 及梁村進約東流，孫村口窄狹，德清軍等處皆被水患。

translations.literal: When Liangcun advanced bonds for the eastern channel, Sunkou village mouth was narrow and constricted; Deqing Army and other places all suffered water calamity.
translations.idiomatic: When bonds were advanced at Liangcun for the eastern flow, Sunkou mouth proved too narrow and Deqing Army and other places were flooded.

sentences.zh: 今春，王宗望等雖于內黃下埽閉斷北流，然至漲水之時，猶有三分水勢，而上流諸埽已多危急，下至將陵埽決壞民田。

translations.literal: This spring, although Wang Zongwang and others closed and cut off the northern channel at the lower revetment in Neihuang, yet when flood water came there was still three parts in ten of the water's force; the upper revetments were already mostly critically endangered, and below at Jiangling revetment the breach destroyed commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: This spring Wang Zongwang and others closed the northern channel at Neihuang's lower revetment, yet at flood stage three-tenths of the flow still ran north; upstream revetments were already critical and the Jiangling revetment burst, ruining farmland.

sentences.zh: 近又據宗望等奏，大河自閉塞闞村而下，及創築新堤七十餘里，盡閉北流，全河之水，東還故道。

translations.literal: Recently again according to Zongwang's memorial, the great river from closing and blocking below Kancun, and newly building dikes for more than seventy li, fully closed the northern channel and the entire river's water returned east to the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang has now reported that below Kancun the river has been sealed, more than seventy li of new dike built, the northern flow fully shut, and the entire river sent east to the old course.

sentences.zh: 今訪聞東流向下，地形已高，水行不快。

translations.literal: Now on inquiry we hear that the eastern channel flowing downward—the terrain is already high and the water runs not fast.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiry shows the eastern channel downstream runs over ground that is already high, so the water moves slowly.

sentences.zh: 既閉斷北流，將來盛夏，大河漲水全歸故道，不惟舊堤損缺怯薄，而闞村新堤，亦恐未易枝梧。

translations.literal: Since the northern channel has been closed and cut off, in the coming midsummer the great river's flood water will all return to the old course—not only are the old dikes damaged, deficient, and weak, but the new dike at Kancun also fears it may not easily be propped up.
translations.idiomatic: With the northern flow shut, next midsummer the full flood will run the old course; not only are the old dikes damaged and weak, but the new Kancun dike may not hold.

sentences.zh: 兼京城上流諸處埽岸，慮有壅滯沖決之患，不可不豫為經畫。」

translations.literal: Moreover upstream of the capital at the various revetments and banks, we fear there may be the worry of blockage, stagnation, and breach—this must be planned in advance."
translations.idiomatic: Upstream of the capital we also fear jams and breaches at the revetments; advance planning is essential."

sentences.zh: 詔：權工部侍郎吳安持、都水使者王宗望、監丞鄭佑同北外監丞司，自闞村而下直至海口，逐一相視，增修疏浚，不致壅滯沖決。

translations.literal: An edict said: Acting Vice Minister of Works Wu Anchì, Director of Waterways Wang Zongwang, and Vice Director Zheng You, together with the Northern Outer Directorate office, from Kancun down to the sea mouth shall inspect one by one, increase repairs and dredge, and not allow blockage, stagnation, or breach.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Acting Vice Minister Wu Anchì, Director Wang Zongwang, Vice Director Zheng You, and the Northern Outer Directorate staff to inspect from Kancun to the sea mouth, repair and dredge as needed, and prevent jams or breaches.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，張商英又言：「今年已閉北流，都水監長貳交章稱賀，或乞付史官，則是河水已歸故道，止宜修緝堤埽，防將來沖決而已。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Zhang Shangying again said: "This year the northern channel has already been closed; the chiefs of the Directorate of Waterways submitted memorials in succession congratulating, some begging to entrust it to the historiographers—then the river water has already returned to the old course, and one need only repair dikes and revetments to guard against future breach.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Zhang Shangying said again: "The northern flow is closed this year; the Directorate chiefs congratulated the throne and some asked the historians to record it—meaning the river is back on the old course and we need only maintain dikes against future breaches.

sentences.zh: 近聞王宗望、李仲卻欲開澶州故道以分水，吳安持乞候漲水前相度。

translations.literal: Recently I hear Wang Zongwang and Li Zhong yet wish to open the old course at Duanzhou to divide water, while Wu Anchì begs to wait and survey before flood water.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I hear Wang Zongwang and Li Zhong now want to open the old Duanzhou channel to split the flow, while Wu Anchì asks to wait until before the flood season to survey.

sentences.zh: 緣開澶州故道，若不與今東流底平，則才經水落，立見淤塞。

translations.literal: Because if one opens the old course at Duanzhou and it is not level with the bottom of the present eastern channel, then as soon as the water falls it will at once be seen silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: If the Duanzhou old channel is opened without matching the eastern channel's bed level, it will silt up as soon as the water falls.

sentences.zh: 若與底平，則從初自合閉口回河，何用九年費財動眾？

translations.literal: If it is level with the bottom, then from the first one ought simply to have closed mouths and returned the river—what use was nine years of spending wealth and mobilizing the masses?
translations.idiomatic: If it could be leveled, we should have closed the mouths and returned the river from the start—why spend nine years and vast resources?

sentences.zh: 安持稱候漲水相度，乃是悠悠之談。

translations.literal: Anchì's claim to wait for flood water before surveying is empty, distant talk.
translations.idiomatic: Anchì's plea to wait for the flood season is empty delay.

sentences.zh: 前來漲水並今來漲水，各至澶州、德清軍界，安持首尾九年，豈得不見？

translations.literal: Previous flood waters and this year's flood waters each reached the borders of Duanzhou and Deqing Army; Anchì from start to finish for nine years—how could he not have seen?
translations.idiomatic: Past floods and this year's floods both reached Duanzhou and Deqing Army—Anchì has been in charge nine years; how could he not know?

sentences.zh: 更欲延至明年，乃是狡兔三窟，自為潛身之計，非公心為國事也。

translations.literal: To wish further to extend to next year is the cunning rabbit's three burrows—a plan to hide oneself, not a public heart for state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing decisions to next year is the trick of a rabbit with three burrows—a way to hide, not service to the state.

sentences.zh: 況立春漸近調夫，如是時不早定議，又留後說，邦財民力，何以支持？

translations.literal: Moreover spring establishment is approaching and corvée laborers will be drafted; if at such a time one does not settle the decision early and again leaves room for later talk, how can state wealth and popular strength be supported?
translations.idiomatic: With spring establishment near and corvée drafts due, if we do not decide now and leave room for more debate, how can treasury and people bear the burden?

sentences.zh: 訪聞先朝水官孫民先、元祐六年水官賈種民各有《河議》，乞取索照會。

translations.literal: On inquiry I hear that the former dynasty's water official Sun Minxian and the Yuanyou sixth-year water official Jia Zhongmin each had a "River Discourse"; I beg to have them sought and consulted by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: I hear that former water officials Sun Minxian and Jia Zhongmin (Yuanyou year 6) each wrote River Discourses; I ask that they be retrieved for reference.

sentences.zh: 召前後本路監司及經歷河事之人，與水官詣都堂反覆詰難，務取至當，經久可行，定議歸一，庶免以有限之財事無涯之功。」

translations.literal: Summon the circuit commissioners of past and present and those who have experienced river affairs, together with the water officials to come to the chief council hall for repeated questioning and challenge, striving to obtain what is most fitting, lasting and feasible, fixing the decision as one—thus hoping to avoid using limited wealth on boundless achievement."
translations.idiomatic: Summon past and present circuit commissioners and veterans of river work, together with the water officials, to the chief council hall for thorough debate, settle on a policy that is sound and durable, unify opinion, and avoid spending finite resources on endless projects."

sentences.zh: 二年七月戊午，詔：「沿黃河州軍，河防決溢，並即申奏。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year on the day wuwu, an edict said: "Along the Yellow River prefectures and armies, if river defenses breach or overflow, all shall immediately memorialize."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year two, on wuwu, an edict ordered: "All Yellow River prefectures and garrisons must report river-defense breaches or overflows at once."

sentences.zh: 元符二年二月乙亥，北外都水丞李偉言：「相度大小河門，乘此水勢衰弱，並先修閉，各立蛾眉埽鎮壓。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Yuanfu on the day yihai, Northern Outer Directorate Vice Director Li Wei said: "Survey the great and small river mouths; taking advantage of this weakening water force, repair and close them all first, each setting an eyebrow-shaped revetment to press down and stabilize.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the second month of the second year of Yuanfu, Northern Outer Vice Director Li Wei proposed: "Survey the main and secondary river mouths; while the current is weak, repair and seal them and set eyebrow revetments to hold each in place.

sentences.zh: 乞次於河北、京東兩路差正夫三萬人，其他夫數，令修河官和雇。」

translations.literal: I beg next to draft thirty thousand regular corvée laborers from the Hebei and Jingdong circuits; for other labor quotas, order the river-repair officials to hire by agreement."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to draft thirty thousand regular laborers from Hebei and Jingdong; other quotas should be hired by the river offices."

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，偉又乞於澶州之南大河身內，開小河一道，以待漲水，紓解大吳口下注北京一帶向著之患。」

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingsi, Wei again begged to open one small river within the great river's body south of Duanzhou to await flood water and relieve the affliction of the area toward Beijing where water from Dawu mouth pours down."
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the third month, Wei also asked to cut a small channel inside the main river south of Duanzhou to take floodwater and ease the threat to the Beijing region below Dawu mouth."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were followed.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 六月末，河決內黃口，東流遂斷絕。

translations.literal: At the end of the sixth month the river breached at Neihuang mouth and the eastern channel was thereby cut off.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the sixth month the river broke at Neihuang mouth, and the eastern flow was cut off.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，詔：「大河水勢十分北流，其以河事付轉運司，責州縣共力救護堤岸。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiaxu, an edict said: "The great river's force is fully ten parts northern flow; entrust river affairs to the Transport Commission and charge prefectures and counties jointly to rescue and protect the dikes."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the eighth month, an edict said: "The great river is running almost entirely north; entrust river work to the Transport Commission and require prefectures and counties to protect the dikes together."

sentences.zh: 辛丑，左司諫王祖道請正吳安持、鄭佑、李仲、李偉之罪，投之遠方，以明先帝北流之志。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Left Remonstrator Wang Zudao of the Secretariat requested punishing Wu Anchì, Zheng You, Li Zhong, and Li Wei and banishing them to distant places, to make clear the late emperor's intent regarding the northern flow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Left Remonstrator Wang Zudao asked that Wu Anchì, Zheng You, Li Zhong, and Li Wei be punished and exiled to clarify the late emperor's policy favoring the northern flow.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 河為中國患，二千歲矣。

translations.literal: The river has been the Middle Kingdom's affliction for two thousand years already.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River has plagued China for two thousand years.

sentences.zh: 自古竭天下之力以事河者，莫如本朝。

translations.literal: From antiquity, those who exhausted the empire's strength to serve the river—none like the present dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Never in history has any age poured the empire's resources into the river as ours has.

sentences.zh: 而徇眾人偏見，欲屈大河之勢以從人者，莫甚于近世。

translations.literal: Yet those who indulge the multitude's biased views and wish to bend the great river's force to follow men—none more than recent times.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in recent times none has indulged popular prejudice more, trying to force the great river to obey human will.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢遠引，只如元祐末年，小吳決溢，議者乃譎謀異計，欲立奇功，以邀厚賞。

translations.literal: Your servant dares not cite distant examples; take only the end of Yuanyou, when Xiaowu breached and overflowed—the deliberators then schemed strange plans, wishing to establish singular merit to seek thick rewards.
translations.idiomatic: I need not reach far back: at the end of Yuanyou, when Xiaowu breached, advocates plotted extravagant schemes to win glory and rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 不顧地勢，不念民力，不惜國用，力建東流之議。

translations.literal: Not considering terrain, not mindful of the people's labor power, not sparing state expenditures—they forcefully built the plan for the eastern flow.
translations.idiomatic: Ignoring terrain, labor, and state expense alike, they pressed hard for the eastern-flow policy.

sentences.zh: 當洪流中，立馬頭，設鋸齒，梢芻材木，耗費百倍。

translations.literal: Amid the torrent, they set horse-head spurs, placed sawtooth structures, floated brush and timber—costs a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-flood they erected horse-head spurs and sawtooth works, launched fascines and timber, at a hundredfold the cost.

sentences.zh: 力遏水勢，使之東注，陵虛駕空，非特行地上而已。

translations.literal: By force blocking the water's force, making it pour east—soaring aloft and riding empty air, not merely running on the ground alone.
translations.idiomatic: They fought the current to drive it east, lifting the channel into the air rather than letting it run on the ground alone.

sentences.zh: 增堤益防，惴惴恐決，澄沙淤泥，久益高仰，一旦決潰，又復北流。

translations.literal: Raising dikes and adding defenses, fearfully dreading breach—clear sand and muddy silt, over time ever higher and steeper; once it breaches and bursts, again it flows north.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes were raised ever higher in fear of a break, but silt piled up until the bed stood steep; when it finally burst, the river turned north again.

sentences.zh: 此非堤防之不固，亦理勢之必至也。

translations.literal: This is not that the dikes and defenses were not solid—it is also the necessary outcome of pattern and force.
translations.idiomatic: This was not mere failure of the dikes; it was the inevitable course of nature.

sentences.zh: 昔禹之治水，不獨行其所無事，亦未嘗不因其變以導之。

translations.literal: In antiquity Yu's governing of water did not only do what cost no effort; he also never failed to follow its changes to guide it.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu tamed the flood he did not only take the easy path; he always worked with the river's shifts to guide it.

sentences.zh: 蓋河流混濁，泥沙相半，流行既久，迄邐淤澱，則久而必決者，勢不能變也。

translations.literal: For the river's flow is turbid, mud and sand half and half; having run long, it reaches downstream silt deposition—then in time it must breach; this force cannot be changed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River is muddy, half water and half silt; the longer it runs the more it silts up downstream, and breach becomes inevitable—no human power can alter that.

sentences.zh: 或北而東，或東而北，亦安可以人力制哉！

translations.literal: Sometimes north then east, sometimes east then north—how could it be controlled by human force!
translations.idiomatic: Whether it turns from north to east or east to north, how can mere human strength control it?

sentences.zh: 為今之策，正宜因其所向，寬立堤防，約欄水勢，使不至大段漫流。

translations.literal: For present strategy, one should rightly follow where it tends, broadly set dikes and defenses, roughly restrain the water's force, so that it does not reach large-scale spreading flow.
translations.idiomatic: Today's policy should follow the river's course: build dikes broadly, restrain the current, and keep it from spreading in wide floods.

sentences.zh: 若恐北流淤澱塘泊，亦祗宜因塘泊之岸，增設堤防，乃為長策。

translations.literal: If one fears the northern flow silting pond-marshes, one also should only follow the pond-marsh shores, add dikes and defenses—that is the long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: If one fears silt from the northern channel filling the border marshes, shore up the marsh banks with dikes—that is the lasting policy.

sentences.zh: 風聞近日又有議者獻東流之計，不獨比年災傷，居民流散，公私匱竭，百無一有，事勢窘急，固不可為；

translations.literal: Heard by rumor recently deliberators again offered the eastern-flow plan; not only have recent years seen disasters, residents scattered, public and private drained—with nothing left, circumstances strained—so it truly cannot be done;
translations.idiomatic: Rumor says advocates have again proposed the eastern flow; after years of disaster, displacement, and empty treasuries, the realm cannot bear it in any case;

sentences.zh: 抑亦自高注下，湍流奔猛，潰決未久，勢不可改。

translations.literal: Moreover from high pouring down, rapids rushing fierce—the breach not long ago—the force cannot be changed.
translations.idiomatic: And since the river now plunges from high ground in a fierce torrent, the recent breach cannot be reversed.

sentences.zh: 設若興工，公私徒耗，殆非利民之舉，實自困之道也。

translations.literal: If one suppose works are raised, public and private will only waste—hardly a benefit to the people; truly a path of self-besiegement.
translations.idiomatic: To launch such works would only drain state and people alike—not help the people but deepen our own plight.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年十月，臣僚言：「昨奉詔措置大河，即由西路曆沿邊州軍，回至武強縣，循河堤至深州，又北下衡水縣，乃達于冀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Chongning, a courtier said: "Yesterday receiving the edict to arrange the great river, immediately from the western route traversed border prefectures and armies, returned to Wuqiang County, followed the river dike to Shenzhou, again north descended to Hengshui County, then reached Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Chongning, officials reported: "Having received orders to manage the great river, we traveled the western route along border prefectures and garrisons, returned to Wuqiang, followed the embankment to Shenzhou, then north to Hengshui and on to Ji.

sentences.zh: 又北渡河過遠來鎮，及分遣屬僚相視恩州之北河流次第。

translations.literal: Again north crossed the river passing Yuanlai Fort, and separately dispatched subordinates to survey the northern channel's sequence north of Enzhou.
translations.idiomatic: We crossed north at Yuanlai Fort and sent subordinates to inspect the northern channel above Enzhou.

sentences.zh: 大抵水性無有不下，引之就高，決不可得。

translations.literal: In general water's nature has nothing that does not flow downward; drawing it toward the high—decidedly cannot be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Water by nature flows downward; to draw it uphill is impossible.

sentences.zh: 況西山積水，勢必欲下，各因其勢而順導之，則無壅遏之患。」

translations.literal: Moreover western hills' accumulated water—its force must wish to descend; each following its force and duly guiding it, then there is no affliction of blockage and restraint."
translations.idiomatic: The western hills hold standing water that will seek the low ground; guide each stream by its own course and nothing will be dammed up.

sentences.zh: 詔開修直河，以殺水勢。

translations.literal: The edict ordered opening and repairing the straight channel to reduce the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the straight channel cut open to ease the current.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，工部言：「乞修蘇村等處運糧河堤為正堤，以支漲水，較修棄堤直堤，可減工四十四萬、料七十一萬有奇。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, the Ministry of Works said: "We beg to repair grain-transport river dikes at Sucun and other places as main dikes to support flood water; comparing repair of abandoned dikes and straight dikes, labor can be reduced four hundred forty thousand and materials seven hundred ten thousand odd."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year four, the Ministry of Works proposed: "Repair the grain-transport embankments at Sucun and elsewhere as main dikes against floods; compared with rebuilding abandoned dikes and straight dikes, this would save some 440,000 labor units and 710,000-odd units of materials."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 閏二月，尚書省言：「大河北流，合西山諸水，在深州武強、瀛州樂壽埽，俯瞰雄、霸、莫州及沿邊塘濼，萬一決溢，為害甚大。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month, the Department of State Affairs said: "The great river's northern flow, joining western hills' various waters, at Wuqiang of Shenzhou and Leshou revetment of Yingzhou—overlooking Xiong, Ba, Mo prefectures and border pond-marshes—if it should breach and overflow, the harm is very great."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month the Secretariat reported: "The northern channel, fed by streams from the western hills, overlooks Xiong, Ba, and Mo and the border marshes from the Wuqiang and Leshou revetments; any breach would do great harm."

sentences.zh: 詔增二埽堤及儲蓄，以備漲水。

translations.literal: The edict ordered increasing the two revetments' dikes and stored reserves to prepare for flood water.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered higher revetment dikes and stored supplies against floods.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大河安流。

translations.literal: That year, the great river flowed peacefully.
translations.idiomatic: That year the great river ran quietly.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，詔滑州系浮橋於北岸，仍築城壘，置官兵守護之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, an edict ordered Huazhou to moor the pontoon bridge on the north bank, and still build walled forts, set officers and troops to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year five, Huazhou was ordered to anchor its floating bridge on the north bank, build fortifications, and station troops to guard it.

sentences.zh: 八月，葺陽武副堤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, repaired the Yangwu secondary dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Yangwu auxiliary embankment was repaired.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年二月，詔于陽武上埽第五鋪開修直河至第十五鋪，以分減水勢。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Daguan, an edict ordered at Yangwu upper revetment fifth station to open and repair the straight channel to the fifteenth station, to divide and reduce the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Daguan, work was ordered on a straight channel from the fifth to the fifteenth station of the Yangwu upper revetment to split and ease the current.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「河身當長三千四百四十步，面闊八十尺，底闊五丈，深七尺，計役十萬七千餘工，用人夫三千五百八十二，凡一月畢。」

translations.literal: The relevant offices said: "The river body should be three thousand four hundred forty paces long, face width eighty chi, bottom width five zhang, depth seven chi; calculated labor one hundred seven thousand odd, using laborers three thousand five hundred eighty-two; all completed in one month."
translations.idiomatic: The offices reported: "The cut should be 3,440 paces long, eighty chi wide at the surface, five zhang wide at the bottom, and seven chi deep—107,000-odd units of labor using 3,582 workers, to finish in one month."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，工部員外郎趙霆言：「南北兩丞司合開直河者，凡為裏八十有七，用緡錢八九萬。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Ministry of Works Assistant Director Zhao Ting said: "North and south two vice director offices together opening straight channels total eighty-seven li, using strings of cash eighty to ninety thousand."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhao Ting of the Ministry of Works noted: "The northern and southern vice directorates together plan eighty-seven li of straight channel at a cost of eighty to ninety thousand strings of cash."

sentences.zh: 異時成功，可免河防之憂，而省久遠之費。」

translations.literal: When successful in time, one can avoid river-defense anxieties and save long-term expenses."
translations.idiomatic: Once completed, they will spare long-term flood-defense costs."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，霆上免夫之議，大略謂：「黃河調發人夫修築埽岸，每歲春首，騷動數路，常至敗家破產。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Ting submitted the proposal to commute corvée, its general purport saying: "The Yellow River drafts corvée laborers to build revetment banks; every year at spring's start it stirs several circuits, often reaching ruined families and broken fortunes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year Zhao Ting submitted a plan to commute corvée, arguing in summary: "The Yellow River drafts laborers each spring to build revetments, disturbing several circuits and often ruining households.

sentences.zh: 今春滑州魚池埽合起夫役，嘗令送免夫之直，用以買土，增貼埽岸，比之調夫，反有贏餘。

translations.literal: This spring Huazhou Yuchi revetment was to raise corvée; they had them deliver the commute corvée payment, using it to buy earth, augment and patch the revetment bank—compared with drafting corvée, there was actually surplus.
translations.idiomatic: This spring at Huazhou's Yuchi revetment they accepted cash in lieu of labor, bought earth to shore the revetment, and had money left over compared with drafting corvée.

sentences.zh: 乞詔有司，應堤埽合調春夫，並依此例，立為永法。」

translations.literal: I beg the edict to relevant offices: wherever dike revetments should draft spring corvée, all follow this precedent and establish it as permanent law."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that all spring corvée on dikes and revetments follow this precedent as standing law."

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「河防夫工，歲役十萬，濱河之民，困於調發。

translations.literal: The edict said: "River-defense corvée labor, yearly service one hundred thousand—the river-bank people are afflicted by drafting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "River-defense labor drafts a hundred thousand men a year and has long burdened the riverside population.

sentences.zh: 可上戶出錢免夫，下戶出力充役，其相度條畫以聞。」

translations.literal: Upper households may pay cash to commute corvée; lower households provide labor to fulfill service; survey and plan the provisions and memorialize."
translations.idiomatic: Let wealthy households pay to commute service and poorer ones supply labor; report the detailed rules."

sentences.zh: 丙申，邢州言河決，陷钜鹿縣。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Xingzhou reported the river breached and engulfed Julu County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xingzhou reported a breach that engulfed Julu County.

sentences.zh: 詔遷縣於高地。

translations.literal: An edict ordered moving the county to high ground.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the county seat moved to higher ground.

sentences.zh: 又以趙州隆平下濕，亦遷之。

translations.literal: Also because Zhaozhou Longping was low and wet, it too was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Longping in Zhaozhou was also relocated because it stood on low, wet ground.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，都水使者吳玠言：「自元豐間小吳口決，北流入御河，下合西山諸水，至清州獨流砦三叉口入海。

translations.literal: On jimao in the sixth month, Directorate Commissioner Wu Jie said: "From between Yuanfeng Xiaowu mouth breached, the northern flow entered the Imperial Canal, below joined western hills' various waters, reaching Qingzhou Dulu Fort triple-fork mouth and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the sixth month, Directorate Commissioner Wu Jie reported: "Since Xiaowu breached in the Yuanfeng era, the northern channel has entered the Imperial Canal, gathered western streams, and reached the sea through the triple fork at Dulu Fort in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 雖深得保固形勝之策，而歲月浸久，侵犯塘堤，沖壞道路，齧損城砦。

translations.literal: Although deeply obtaining the policy of securing strategic terrain, yet as years gradually lengthen it encroaches on pond dikes, washes out roads, gnaws and damages walled forts.
translations.idiomatic: Though this secured the strategic terrain, over the years it has eroded lagoon dikes, washed out roads, and damaged frontier forts.

sentences.zh: 臣奉詔修治堤防，禦捍漲溢。

translations.literal: Your servant received the edict to repair dikes and defenses, repel and withstand flood overflow.
translations.idiomatic: I have been ordered to repair the embankments and hold back floods.

sentences.zh: 然築八尺之堤，當九河之尾，恐不能敵。

translations.literal: Yet building eight-chi dikes at the nine rivers' tail—I fear cannot withstand.
translations.idiomatic: But an eight-chi dike at the tail of the nine rivers may not hold.

sentences.zh: 若不遇有損缺，逐旋增修，即又至隳壞，使與塘水相通，于邊防非計也。

translations.literal: If one does not encounter damage and loss, and incrementally repairs—then again it reaches ruin, making it connect with pond water—for border defense this is not a plan.
translations.idiomatic: Patching only after damage will let the ponds merge with the channel and undermine border defense.

sentences.zh: 乞降旨修葺。」

translations.literal: I beg an edict to descend for repair."
translations.idiomatic: I request orders for full repair."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，冀州河溢，壞信都、南宮兩縣。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jizhou's river overflowed, ruining Xindu and Nangong two counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, flooding in Jizhou destroyed Xindu and Nangong counties.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，詔沈純誠開撩兔源河。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, an edict ordered Shen Chuncheng to open and dredge Tuyuan River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year three, Shen Chuncheng was ordered to open and dredge the Tuyuan River.

sentences.zh: 兔源在廣武埽對岸，分減埽下漲水也。

translations.literal: Tuyuan is on the opposite bank from Guangwu revetment, dividing and reducing flood water below the revetment.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuan lies across from the Guangwu revetment and diverts high water below it.

sentences.zh: 政和四年十一月，都水使者孟昌齡言：「今歲夏秋漲水，河流上下並行中道，滑州浮橋不勞解拆，大省歲費。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Zhenghe, Directorate Commissioner Meng Changling said: "This year's summer-autumn flood water—the river above and below both ran the middle channel; Huazhou's pontoon bridge needed no labor to dismantle—greatly saving yearly expense."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Zhenghe, Meng Changling reported: "This summer and autumn the river held to the middle course, so Huazhou's bridge did not need dismantling and annual costs fell sharply."

sentences.zh: 詔許稱賀，官吏推恩有差。

translations.literal: The edict permitted congratulation; officials' extended grace had differences.
translations.idiomatic: The court allowed congratulations and graded rewards for the officials.

sentences.zh: 昌齡又獻議導河大伾，可置永遠浮橋，謂：「河流自大伾之東而來，直大伾山西，而止，數里方回南，東轉而過，復折北而東，則又直至大伾山之東，亦止不過十里耳。

translations.literal: Changling again offered a plan to guide the river at Daqi, and could set a forever pontoon bridge, saying: "The river's flow comes from east of Daqi, runs straight to Daqi Mountain's west and stops; several li only then turns south, east turns and passes, again bends north then east—then again runs straight to Daqi Mountain's east, also stopping for no more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Changling also proposed routing the river past Mount Daqi and placing a permanent bridge, saying: "The river approaches from east of Daqi, runs west of the mountain and stops; after a few li it bends south, turns east, then north again, and again halts east of Daqi—all within about ten li.

sentences.zh: 視地形水勢，東西相直徑易，曾不十餘里間，且地勢低下，可以成河，倚山可為馬頭，又有中氵單，正如河陽。

translations.literal: Viewing terrain and water force, east and west directly opposite—the span is easy, within scarcely ten-odd li; moreover terrain is low and can become a river, leaning on the mountain one can make horse-heads, and there is also a mid-channel bar, just like Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain and current make an east-west crossing easy over barely ten li; the ground is low enough to cut a channel, cliffs can serve as horse-heads, and a mid-channel bar lies between, much like Heyang.

sentences.zh: 若引使穿大伾大山及東北二小山，分為兩股而過，合於下流，因是三山為趾，以系浮梁，省費數十百倍，可寬河朔諸路之役。」

translations.literal: If one leads it to pierce Daqi great mountain and the two small northeast mountains, divide into two streams and pass, join at lower flow—thereby using the three mountains as footings to moor the floating bridge, saving expense by tens and hundreds of times, and can ease corvée on Heshuo circuits."
translations.idiomatic: If the river were cut through Mount Daqi and the two lesser hills to the northeast in two branches reuniting downstream, the three peaks could anchor a floating bridge at a fraction of the cost and ease labor across the north."

sentences.zh: 朝廷喜而從之。

translations.literal: The court was pleased and followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The court welcomed the plan and approved it.

sentences.zh: 五年，置提舉修系永橋所。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, established the supervisory office for repairing and mooring the forever bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In year five a supervisory office for the permanent bridges was established.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，降德音于河北、京東、京西路，其略曰：「鑿山釃渠，循九河既道之跡；

translations.literal: On guichou in the sixth month, a gracious amnesty was proclaimed on Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi circuits; its summary said: "Cutting mountains and digging channels, following the nine rivers' already-channelled traces;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the sixth month an amnesty was proclaimed in Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi, declaring in part: "We cut through mountains and opened channels along the tracks of Yu's nine rivers;

sentences.zh: 為梁跨趾，成萬世永賴之功。

translations.literal: Making a bridge span the footings, completing work to be relied on for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: and bridged their footing to achieve a benefit that will last ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 役不逾時，慮無愆素。

translations.literal: Labor did not exceed the season; I fear no neglect of constancy.
translations.idiomatic: The work finished on schedule without neglect.

sentences.zh: 人絕往來之阻，地無南北之殊。

translations.literal: People ended the obstruction of coming and going; land had no north-south difference.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers are no longer blocked, and no place is cut off north from south.

sentences.zh: 靈祗懷柔，黎庶呼舞。

translations.literal: Spiritual powers were gentle and yielding; the common people shouted and danced.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are appeased and the people rejoice.

sentences.zh: 眷言朔野，爰暨近畿，畚鍤繁興，薪芻轉徙，民亦勞止，朕甚憫之。

translations.literal: Turning words to the northern wilds, reaching to the near capital districts—baskets and spades flourished, fuel and fodder shifted and moved; the people also labored and stopped—I deeply pity them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the northern frontier and the capital districts have seen shovels busy and supplies moved—the people have labored, and We deeply pity them.

sentences.zh: 宜推在宥之恩，仍廣蠲除之惠。

translations.literal: One should extend the grace of forbearance and still broaden the favor of remission and exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Let them enjoy Our leniency and receive broad tax relief.

sentences.zh: 應開河官吏，令提舉所具功力等第聞奏。」

translations.literal: All river-opening officials—order the supervisory office to present grades of work merit and memorialize."
translations.idiomatic: Let the supervisory office report graded rewards for officials who opened the channel.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「居山至大伾山浮橋屬浚州者，賜名天成橋；

translations.literal: Again an edict: "The pontoon bridge from Jushan to Daqi Mountain belonging to Xunzhou is bestowed the name Tiancheng Bridge;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict named the bridge from Jushan to Mount Daqi in Xunzhou the Tiancheng Bridge;

sentences.zh: 大伾山至汶子山浮橋屬滑州者，賜名榮光橋。」

translations.literal: From Daqi Mountain to Wenzi Mountain pontoon bridge belonging to Huazhou, bestowed the name Rongguang Bridge."
translations.idiomatic: and the bridge from Mount Daqi to Mount Wenzi in Huazhou the Rongguang Bridge.

sentences.zh: 俄改榮光曰聖功。

translations.literal: Soon changed Rongguang to Shengong.
translations.idiomatic: Rongguang was soon renamed Shengong.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，御制橋名，磨崖以刻之。

translations.literal: On gengchen in the seventh month, imperial composition of bridge names, cliff face polished to carve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the emperor composed the bridge names and had them engraved on the cliff.

sentences.zh: 方河之開也，水流雖通，然湍激猛暴，遇山稍隘，往往泛溢，近砦民夫多被漂溺，因亦及通利軍，其後遂注成巨濼雲。

translations.literal: When the river was being opened, the water flow though connected—yet rapids were fierce and violent; meeting mountains somewhat narrow, often overflowed; near-fort corvée laborers many were swept and drowned, thus also reaching Tongli Army—afterward it poured and formed a great marsh.
translations.idiomatic: When the channel was first cut the water ran through, but the current was violent; where it narrowed at the hills it often flooded, drowning workers near the forts and reaching Tongli Army—later forming a vast marsh.

sentences.zh: 是月，昌齡遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: That month, Changling was transferred to Ministry of Works Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: That month Meng Changling was promoted to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，都水監言：「大河以就三山通流，正在通利之東，慮水溢為患。

translations.literal: On jihai in the eighth month, the Directorate of Waterways said: "The great river having achieved the three mountains' connected flow, is just east of Tongli—I fear water overflow as affliction.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth month the Directorate of Waterways reported: "With the river now flowing through the three mountains just east of Tongli, We fear flooding.

sentences.zh: 乞移軍城於大伾山、居山之間，以就高仰。」

translations.literal: I beg to move the army fort between Daqi Mountain and Jushan, to reach high ground."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to move the garrison between Mount Daqi and Jushan to higher ground."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，中書省言冀州棗強埽決，知州辛昌宗武臣，不諳河事，詔以王仲元代之。

translations.literal: On dingsi in the tenth month, Secretariat said Jizhou's Zaoqiang revetment breached; prefect Xin Changzong was a martial official, not versed in river affairs—edict used Wang Zhongyuan to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the tenth month the Secretariat reported a breach at Zaoqiang revetment in Jizhou; Prefect Xin Changzong, a military appointee ignorant of river work, was replaced by Wang Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，都水使者孟揆言：「大河連經漲淤，灘面已高，致河流傾側東岸。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the eleventh month, Directorate Commissioner Meng Kuo said: "The great river having repeatedly undergone flood siltation, the shoal face is already high, causing the river flow to tilt toward the east bank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eleventh month Meng Kuo reported: "Repeated floods have raised the shoals and tipped the river toward the east bank.

sentences.zh: 今若修閉棗強上埽決口，其費不貲，兼冬深難施人力，縱使極力修閉，東堤上下二百餘里，必須盡行增築，與水爭力，未能全免決溢之患。

translations.literal: Now if one repairs and closes the Zaoqiang upper revetment breach opening, the expense is incalculable; moreover winter is deep and hard to apply human force—even if with utmost force repairing and closing, the east dike above and below two hundred-odd li must all be heightened and built, contending force with water—unable fully to avoid breach-overflow affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Closing the upper Zaoqiang breach would cost a fortune; deep winter forbids heavy labor, and even a full repair would require raising two hundred-odd li of east embankment—fighting the river—without wholly preventing breaches.

sentences.zh: 今漫水行流，多堿鹵及積水之地，又不犯州軍，止經數縣地分，迤邐纏御河歸納黃河。

translations.literal: Now the spreading water's running flow mostly crosses alkaline brine and accumulated-water lands, also not offending prefectures and armies—only passing several counties' territories, winding to coil the Imperial Canal and return and receive into the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The overflow now crosses saline flats and standing pools, avoids prefectures and garrisons, passes only a few counties, and winds back to the Imperial Canal and the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 欲自決口上恩州之地水堤為始，增補舊堤，接續御河東岸，簽合大河。」

translations.literal: I wish from the breach mouth upward at Enzhou's terrain-water dike as start, augment and patch the old dike, continue along the Imperial Canal's east bank, join and seal the great river."
translations.idiomatic: I propose to begin above the breach at Enzhou's flood dike, strengthen the old embankment, link it along the east bank of the Imperial Canal, and tie it back into the main river."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，臣僚言：「禹跡湮沒於數千載之遠，陛下神智獨運，一旦興復，導河三山。

translations.literal: On yihai, courtiers said: "Yu's traces buried in several thousand years' distance—Your Majesty's divine wisdom alone moved; in one day revived, guiding the river through three mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai officials said: "Yu's work lay buried for millennia until Your Majesty's wisdom restored it at once, routing the river through three mountains.

sentences.zh: 長堤盤固，橫截巨浸，依山為梁，天造地設。

translations.literal: Long dikes coiled solid, horizontally cutting the great inundation, leaning on mountains as bridge—heaven made, earth set.
translations.idiomatic: Long embankments coil firm; a bridge spans the flood leaning on the hills—heaven and earth themselves seemed to ordain it.

sentences.zh: 威示南北，度越前古，歲無解系之費，人無病涉之患。

translations.literal: Might displayed north and south, surpassed former antiquity; years without dismantling expense, people without the affliction of troubled crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Your might spans north and south, surpassing all earlier ages: no yearly cost of dismantling bridges, no hardship for travelers.

sentences.zh: 大功既成，願申飭有司，以日繼月，視水向著，隨為堤防，益加增固，每遇漲水，水官、漕臣不輟巡視。」

translations.literal: Great work already accomplished—I wish to instruct relevant offices, day following month, watch where water tends, accordingly make dikes and defenses, increasingly add solidification; every time flood water comes, water officials and transport commissioners without cease patrol and inspect."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the great work is done, I urge the offices daily and monthly to watch the river's course, strengthen the dikes, and have water and transport officials patrol without cease in every flood."

sentences.zh: 詔付昌齡。

translations.literal: The edict entrusted it to Changling.
translations.idiomatic: The edict referred the matter to Changling.

sentences.zh: 六年四月辛卯，高陽關路安撫使吳玠言冀州棗強縣黃河清，詔許稱賀。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the fourth month of the sixth year, Gaoyang Pass Circuit Pacification Commissioner Wu Jie said Zaoqiang County of Jizhou's Yellow River was clear—the edict permitted congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fourth month of year six Wu Jie reported the Yellow River clear at Zaoqiang in Jizhou, and the court allowed congratulations.

sentences.zh: 七月戊午，太師蔡京請名三山橋銘閣曰纘禹繼文之閣，門曰銘功之門。

translations.literal: On wuwu in the seventh month, Grand Preceptor Cai Jing requested naming the Three Mountains Bridge inscription pavilion Continuing Yu and Carrying on Culture Pavilion, the gate Achievement Inscription Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the seventh month Grand Preceptor Cai Jing proposed naming the bridge inscription pavilion the Carry On Yu Pavilion and its gate the Record Merit Gate.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，蔡京等言：「冀州河清，乞拜表稱賀。」

translations.literal: On xinmao in the tenth month, Cai Jing and others said: "Jizhou's river is clear—I beg to present a congratulatory memorial."
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the tenth month Cai Jing and others asked to submit a memorial of congratulations on Jizhou's clear river.

sentences.zh: 七年五月丁巳，臣僚言：「恩州甯化鎮大河之側，地勢低下，正當灣流沖激之處。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, on the day dingsi, officials said: "Beside the Great River at Ninghua Town in En Prefecture, the terrain lies low, right where a bend in the current strikes and rushes.
